summary: Describes ansible-pull, which inverts the architecture so nodes check out a git repo of configuration and run ansible-playbook themselves; it scales with a load-balanced checkout location.
questions: Can managed nodes pull their configuration instead of me pushing it?

answer_card.title: ansible-pull
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible-pull` lets nodes check in to a central location: it checks out a git repo of playbooks and runs `ansible-playbook` against it locally. With a load-balanced checkout location it scales very well. See `ansible-pull --help`.
